data.gender_notes: Sharvad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvad is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shraddha' which means 'faith, belief, trust'. The prefix 'Shar' in the name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which is the name of the God of Sacred Ash. Thus, the name Sharvad signifies one who has deep faith and devotion towards the God of Sacred Ash. The name Sharvad carries the meaning “God of Sacred Ash” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvad usually hope their child will grow to embody god of sacred ash and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharvad is a spiritual name that signifies one's deep connection and faith towards the God of Sacred Ash. It is believed that individuals with this name possess strong spiritual beliefs and a deep sense of devotion towards their faith.
